raw:
Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The Planner misinterpreted the core purpose of a standardized taxonomic classification system. Instead of recognizing that standardization primarily ensures a "consistent definition" (Option C) allowing scientists to communicate and compare data universally, the Planner incorrectly prioritized "geographical habitats" (Option B). The reasoning conflated the utility of standardized *distribution maps* (which rely on consistent definitions) with the definition of the classification system itself. This represents a failure to align the reasoning with the foundational concept of taxonomy (scientific consistency) and a premature declaration of task completion without verifying the options against established biological principles.
